description.fallback: Confused as to how many Stand users are present in the ship, the Joestar group splits up to look for any traces of a Stand. The sailors wait on the deck with the runaway girl. The girl approaches the orangutan Forever and seeing it communicate with gestures, offer her a cleanly cut apple and light a match to smoke, is surprised by its intelligence.

outro.fallback: After a short battle, Jotaro is suddenly hit by one of the ship's fans, which throws itself at Jotaro.
Confused, Jotaro wonders where Forever's Stand is hiding and why he can't see it.
